IMPL-TIED_BOUNDED_PILOT_BUDGET.proof_boundary: Structural pseudo-code shape, token linkage, and dependency diagnostics only; behavioral test coverage remains separate.

failure_modes: OUTPUT: normalized pilot budget | error InvalidPilotBudget | error OptInRequired | error DuplicateNamespace
IF bounded_composition opt-in flag is false: RETURN error OptInRequired
IF schema_version is not pilot-budget.v1: RETURN error InvalidPilotBudget
IF k <= 0 OR mode not in {parallel, sequential}: RETURN error InvalidPilotBudget
IF seed missing OR run_namespace missing OR cost_ceiling missing OR stop_criteria missing: RETURN error InvalidPilotBudget
IF run_namespace duplicates an active namespace for the same request_token: RETURN error DuplicateNamespace

IMPL-TIED_BOUNDED_TRAJECTORY_EVIDENCE.proof_boundary: Structural pseudo-code shape, token linkage, and dependency diagnostics only; behavioral test coverage remains separate.

failure_modes: OUTPUT: manifest artifact descriptor | error WrongBasePath | error PrivacyRedactionFailure | error MissingProvenance
IF tied base path != intended project tied-project: RETURN error WrongBasePath
IF redaction fails: RETURN error PrivacyRedactionFailure
IF required provenance ref missing: RETURN error MissingProvenance

IMPL-TIED_BOUNDED_DIVERGENCE_ANALYSIS.proof_boundary: Structural pseudo-code shape, token linkage, and dependency diagnostics only; behavioral test coverage remains separate.

failure_modes: OUTPUT: divergence report descriptor | error StaleManifest | error RequestScopeViolation
FOR EACH manifest: IF request_token mismatch: RETURN error RequestScopeViolation
IF any manifest stale: RETURN error StaleManifest

IMPL-TIED_BOUNDED_LESSON_DISTILLATION.proof_boundary: Structural pseudo-code shape, token linkage, and dependency diagnostics only; behavioral test coverage remains separate.

failure_modes: OUTPUT: lesson draft bundle | error StaleReport | error IneligibleInput

IF report ineligible or missing required contrast rows: RETURN error IneligibleInput
IF duplicate group already recorded for same stable identity: RETURN error DuplicateSuppressed
